_comment: Missions launched from the territory map (issue #5). province: where the map offers it. map: text map in maps/. story: true = plays once. after: only offered once that mission is cleared. needs: story conditions (scripts/story.gd Story.meets, issue #18). intro: a talk played when the mission starts (first time only). objective: {kind, ...} read by scripts/objective.gd (kills: count). rewards: paid on success (gilt, supplies, ink, renown, insight). fray: change to the province's Fray on success (negative pushes the Blank back). enemies: optional spawn weights that replace the province roster in data/enemies.json (#16). gate (issue #28): story conditions that keep a story mission on the map but locked, with the first missing one shown as the reason. on_success (issue #28): story effects on the first win: grant (provinces that become yours), join (recruits who join on the spot), standing ({faction: change}). loot: per-kill chance [0-1] and amount range of what the party picks up on the way; retreating keeps it, being wiped out loses it.

missions.name: Prologue: Spat Out
missions.brief: Something spat you out of the Blank in the Frayed Meadow, and the Nibblers want you back. Drive them off and find your way to Hollowmark.

missions.name: Chapter 1: No Such Person
missions.brief: The Blank is eating the Concord tax office with you locked inside it. Bran has the key. The wardens have other ideas.

missions.name: The Concord Answers
missions.brief: A Concord tithe column is marching on Hollowmark to collect 'all outstanding sums', meaning you. Break it at Old Mill Crossing before it reaches the gate.

missions.name: Patrol: Frayed Meadow
missions.brief: The Nibblers keep crawling out of the white. Thin them out before they reach the road, and the Meadow frays a little slower.

missions.name: Patrol: Gutterwoods
missions.brief: The letter-moths are thick between the trees again. Clear the trail so the Coven's couriers get through.

missions.name: Patrol: Saltreed Marsh
missions.brief: Reedlings have been spitting at anyone on the boardwalks. Wade in and thin them out.

missions.name: Patrol: Old Mill Crossing
missions.brief: Something stitched the mill's scarecrows back together. Put them down before the harvest rots.

missions.name: Patrol: Wickham Hills
missions.brief: The ink spring draws things out of the hills. Walk the lamp road and see what comes.

missions.name: Patrol: The Tithe Road
missions.brief: Guild sellswords are working the Concord road. Make the toll they collect a painful one.

missions.name: Boss: The Auditor
missions.brief: The Concord has sent its answer to an unregistered town: the Auditor, who strikes people out of the Ledger with a quill the size of a lance. He is waiting at the Tithe Road tollgate, and Hollowmark is next on his list. Watch the red lanes and the dotted lines, and hit him when his nib sticks.

missions.name: Chapter 2: The Wax Barges
missions.brief: The Erasers are burning the wax barges at Candleford, the lake town that makes Saint Ledger's candles. Get down to the jetty and keep the last barge afloat. Nobody holds Candleford yet: save it and it is yours.

steps.label: Get down to the wax jetty
banter: bran
White fire. No heat off it. That ain't right.

steps.label: Drive the Erasers off the jetty

elite.name: Reader Grice, keeper of the list

banter: bran
They're readin' names at us. While they swing.
done_banter: One boat left. Let's keep it.

steps.label: Reach the last barge
Keep the Erasers' tapers off the last barge
steps.say: The Erasers want the last barge. Stand between them and the wax.
steps.fail: The last barge went up in white fire. Candleford will make candles for nobody this winter.

steps.label: Walk back up through the town

missions.name: Chapter 2: The Copying Hall
missions.brief: Prioress Ebba will let you into Saint Ledger's now that Candleford has someone in charge. Things that used to be brothers do penance in the cloister walk. Get through to the copying hall and light the candles at its three lecterns, so the copyists can see what they are writing.

objective.label: Meet the Prioress at the gate

steps.label: Walk the cloister
banter: gristle
Candles in every niche and still dark. Takes effort, that does.

steps.label: Put the penitents to rest
steps.say: Penitents wipe off what they touch. Keep your distance from their hands.
done_banter: They was monks. Now they ain't. Let's not stop and think about it.

steps.label: Into the copying hall
Light the candles at the three lecterns
steps.say: Copyists strike a strip of floor out of the world. Step off the dotted line.

steps.label: Out the way you came, with the Prioress

missions.name: Chapter 2: The Crypts
missions.brief: The Erasers took the Bonefield Cloister a month ago and sealed its crypt-keeper, Sister Osyth, underground. Break their camp, go down the crypt stair and bring her out. The Ledger says the hill was always empty.

steps.label: Climb to the Erasers' camp
Break the Erasers' camp
banter: ninefingers
Readers up front, washers behind. Same drill as a tithe line. Go.
done_banter: Askew's gone. Left the tents. Didn't leave the fire.

steps.label: Through the charnel chapel
Clear the chapel
Down the crypt stair
banter: bran
Steps go down further than the hill goes up. I'm only sayin'.

steps.label: Find the crypt-keeper
Clear the ossuary
Hold the stair while Osyth opens the Founders' Door
steps.fail: The crypt took Sister Osyth before she reached the last row.

steps.label: Through the Founders' Door
Bring Sister Osyth up into the light

missions.name: Boss: The Abbot Who Copied Himself
missions.brief: Abbot Wulfstan has locked the copying hall and copied himself, several times. Only one of him is real: his hands drip ink. Hit the copies and they tear, but they come back. Watch his crozier, the dotted lines, and the ring of light when he illuminates.

missions._comment: The climax betrayal, Chapter 6 (issue #186): the betrayer's fight in their home written as words, offered once Chapter 5 has locked them (needs betrayer), even when the home is erased (in_blank). The gesture is the outro talk's choice. Chapter 6 (#32) adds its own 'after'.
missions.name: The Betrayal: Ottoline's Door
missions.brief: Ottoline took the Vacancy's deal and walked Ash into the white. She is standing guard over the Encore's red door, inside Gallows Ferry as the Blank keeps it. She fights the way she always did: the shoulder charge down a lane, both fists into the floor, and one punch you will see coming for a long time.

objective.label: Bring Ottoline down. Don't finish her.

missions.name: The Betrayal: Daro's Road
missions.brief: Daro signed the Vacancy's form and handed Ash over. They are waiting on the Tithe Road as written, beside a Hob's Wick that may or may not be real. Watch the point: the long lunge, the sweep up close, and the Skewer, a line the length of the road.

objective.label: Bring Daro down. Don't finish them.

missions.name: The Betrayal: Odile's Account
missions.brief: Odile entered the deal in her ledger and paid it with Ash. She is at Old Mill Crossing as written, outside the Honest Measure. Levy drains you to heal her; stand out of her Audit seals, or her hits land half again as hard.

objective.label: Bring Odile down. Don't finish her.

missions._comment: Bran's con paid off (issue #186): he sold Ash for a price the Vacancy can't pay, and it is in breach. Brings him home (on_success betrayal: con_home).
missions.name: The Con: Bran's Thursday
missions.brief: Bran sold Ash to the Vacancy for everything it ever ate, back, by Thursday. It said yes. It is Thursday. Find him at the landing in Gallows Ferry as written, and keep the Vacancy's collectors off him while he makes it pay.

steps.label: Find Bran at the landing
Keep the collectors off Bran while the Vacancy fails to pay
steps.fail: The collectors got to the contract. The Vacancy is not in breach any more.

steps.label: Walk back up Lantern Row

missions.name: Patrol: Candleford
missions.brief: White coats still row out at night to the barges. Walk the lake shore and see who is carrying a taper.

missions.name: Patrol: Saint Ledger's
missions.brief: The Prioress asks for the abbey lands to be walked. Penitents wander out of the cloister and into the orchards.

missions.name: Patrol: The Bonefield
missions.brief: The Erasers left, but their fires did not all go out. Walk the hill and stamp out what is still burning.

missions.name: Patrol: Scarth Pass
missions.brief: Pilgrims, bandits and penitents share the pass road. Walk it and keep the pines clear.

missions.name: Patrol: Lantern Quay
missions.brief: The Guild pays for the lamps and the lake pays for nothing. Walk the wharves before the eels come up for the night shift.

missions.name: Patrol: Pendower Shallows
missions.brief: The dockfolk you brought across are mending word-nets on the flats. Something keeps mending them back the other way. Walk the shallows.

missions.name: Patrol: Vauclair Terraces
missions.brief: The pickers say the vines whisper the vintage back at them, and the scarecrows have started dancing. Walk the rows before the harvest goes to the wrong party.

missions.name: Patrol: The Velvet Causeway
missions.brief: The masquerade never quite ends on the bridges. Walk them after midnight and see off whoever is still dancing with teeth.

missions.name: Chapter 3: The Singer on the Quay
missions.brief: The Blank has bitten Lantern Quay in two. On the far side, forty-odd dockfolk are trapped against the ink, and a cabaret singer is holding a bridge of light across the gap by singing it. Keep the eels and the revellers off her until the last of them is across.

steps.label: Get down onto the quay
banter: bran
Music. On a sinkin' wharf. This lake's got no sense of occasion.

steps.label: Clear the wharf
banter: bran
Eels in the ink and dancers on the boards. Pick one.

steps.label: Reach the singer at the gap
Keep the eels off Saffron while the dockfolk cross
steps.say: Every second she sings, another family crosses the light. Stand between her and the ink.
steps.fail: The song broke. The bridge of light went out with people still on it.

steps.label: Walk back up the quay with the dockfolk

missions.name: Chapter 3: The Masquerade
missions.brief: The Velvet Causeway has been dancing for a year while the ink lake comes up the steps. Hortense de Saulx, the Velvet Marquise, has invited the person who does not exist. Go in masked, find her, and find out who eats the guests.

steps.label: Cross the bridges to the masquerade hall
banter: saffron
Mind the third step, loves. It was the fifth step last spring.

steps.label: The bridge duellists want a bout
banter: saffron
Bridge duellists! They salute before they lunge. Watch the salute.

steps.label: Into the great hall
Look up at the balcony
Back down to the dance floor
The revellers turn hungry
banter: saffron
They spin before they come at you! Step out of the spin!

steps.label: Leave the masquerade with the Marquise

missions.name: Chapter 3: Shadow and Debt
missions.brief: Word-fishers on Pendower Shallows net words out of the ink lake and sell them by the pound. A grifter with a talking shadow is fleecing them, and her shadow is about to give her away just as the eels come up. Optional: the grifter is worth having.

steps.label: Walk out to the word-nets
Eels in the nets
banter: nan
Not the eels! I owe one of them money!

steps.label: Out onto the flats after the grifter
The lamplighters' gang wants its cut
banter: tally
These men are owed money by Nan. They are telling the truth. I would know.
done_banter: Square! Call it square, lads. You can't argue, you're lying down.

steps.label: Walk back off the Shallows

missions.name: Chapter 3: The Night Wharf
missions.brief: After midnight a Concord barge with no lights takes on crates at Lantern Quay. Saffron has seen people in masks go into those crates. Hortense knows a quick way onto the wharf. Bran does not like how well she knows it.

steps.label: Keep to the dark side of the warehouses
The wharf's night lamplighters
banter: hortense
Lamplighters. They work for whoever pays for the oil. Tonight that is the Concord.

steps.label: Up the gangway onto the barge
Purser Gaudin's marines
banter: hortense
Concord marines. They hate the water and they hate me. Tonight they get both.
done_banter: The crates, Ash. Open the crates.

steps.label: Break open the crates
Walk the debtors off the wharf

missions.name: Boss: The Host
missions.brief: At the head of the masquerade's table sits the guest nobody invited: the Host, mostly mouth. It bites, it talks in volleys of words that hurt, and when it breathes in, everything near it slides towards the mouth. Keep out of the inhale, and kill the guests it calls before it swallows them to heal.

objective.label: Go up to the banqueting room

missions.name: Chapter 4: The Wave at Trevail
missions.brief: Trevail Harbour lives under a wave that stopped before it broke. The fleet that was out past the bar is still sailing into the white, and the harbour bell is the only thing that turns boats round. Get Harbourmaster Pascoe to the bell tower, then keep the sea's leftovers off her while she rings them home.

steps.label: Walk down the quay under the wave
banter: bran
There's a wave over the 'ole town. Holdin' still. I don't trust things that hold still.

steps.label: Breakers on the slipway
banter: pascoe
Those are bits of the wave walked off on their own. When one rears up, get out from under it.

steps.label: Get the harbourmaster to the bell tower
Keep the drowned off the tower while Pascoe rings the boats home
steps.say: Every boat that hears the bell comes about. Keep the sea off the tower steps.
steps.fail: The bell stopped. Out past the bar, the last boats sailed on into the white.

steps.label: Walk back up the quay with the fishing families

missions.name: Chapter 4: The Knight in the Glass
missions.brief: At Halfwave the sea stopped twenty yards short of the beach, and the tideline is a wall of standing water. The drowned walk out of it crusted in salt. In the bay's chapel hangs the looking-glass the fishing families kept for their dead, and since the sea stopped there has been a woman in armour in it, talking.

steps.label: Along the strand to the chapel
The drowned walk out of the tideline
banter: ilse
You on the beach! The salt ones get up again unless you break the heap. Ilse has watched them do it all week. She was magnificent about it.
done_banter: Voice is comin' from the chapel. Course it is.

steps.label: Into the roofless chapel
The tideline breaks into the chapel
banter: ilse
Left! Your other left. Everything is the wrong way round out here. Ilse is adjusting beautifully.
done_banter: There. That was well done. Ilse was well done. You were adequate.

steps.label: Walk the knight up off the beach

missions.name: Chapter 4: The Keeper's Light
missions.brief: Polgarrow Light stands on a rock at the end of the coast, shining out over nothing. Its keeper went up the tower the night the sea stopped and has not come down. Kerra Hocking says he talks all night in a voice with gaps in it. Climb the rock, relight the lamp, and hear what he has to say.

steps.label: Up the rock path to the Light
Gannets over the rock
banter: kerra
Watch the shadow on the ground! When it stops moving, it's coming down.

steps.label: Up to the lamp room
Relight the lamp
Something out on the water answers the light
Take the keeper down off the rock

missions.name: Boss: Low Water
missions.brief: Out past the standing wall of the tide at Halfwave the sea bed is bare for a mile, and at the bottom of the bay something has gathered up all the water the tide forgot to bring back. The Moot calls it Low Water. It rolls waves down the bay, spits brine and turns the sand to whirlpools. When the tide turns it sinks, and the whole bay floods except the pale high banks: get onto one.

objective.label: Walk out onto the sea bed
